rawContent: Sophia Huang Xueqin (黄雪琴) is an activist and journalist who reported extensively on the #MeToo movement in China. She was leaving China to study at @SussexUni when she was stopped by police.  She's now in prison for “inciting subversion of state power”. https://t.co/5shgj06Ob0 https://t.co/yWR2YCTOvi
